name: MALTESE CROSS
description: Maltese Cross is a domino game played with a double-six set. It takes its name from the tableau layout that resembles a Maltese Cross. The game features a unique two-phase setup where players first build four arms around a central spinner, then add doubles crosswise to complete the cross shape before regular play continues.

content.text: Maltese Cross is a domino game played with a double-six set. It takes its name from the tableau layout that resembles a Maltese Cross. The game features a unique two-phase setup where players first build four arms around a central spinner, then add doubles crosswise to complete the cross shape before regular play continues.
A member of the Cyprus family of domino games, named after the distinctive Maltese Cross pattern formed by the tableau during play.
Standard double-six domino set (28 tiles). For 2 players: 7 tiles each. For 3-4 players: 5-6 tiles each.
